versions.changelog:
cv-skill 1.1.0 - Harvard HES 2024 refresh

- Added cover letter workflow, schema fields, and guidance for role-targeted application packages.
- Added Harvard Extension School 2024 resume and cover letter checklist as a paraphrased reference.
- Expanded resume rewriting guidance with bullet quality checks, action verb families, and cover letter structure.
- Added target-role metadata, page size/language/section label options, and sample cover letter data.
- Updated generator to support letter/A4 page sizes and English/Chinese section headings.
- Added requirements.txt for python-docx dependency clarity.

cv-skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Create professional Harvard-style, single-column resumes from structured data or candidate inputs.
- Supports multiple job-targeted resume versions, translation to any language, and exports in DOCX/PDF formats.
- Focus on concise, factual bullets with clean hierarchy—no fluff, adjectives, or self-evaluation phrases.
- Includes scripts, data schema, rewriting guidance, and safe sample input for easy generation and customization.
- Enforces strong safety rules: no hardcoded candidate data, secrets, or unsafe outputs.
